[EN] {@RawItem:206821} is famous for its wondrous purification powers. Why, it's only possible to rely on the village's oasis for our drinking water because there is {@RawItem:206821} at the bottom of that very oasis.

It is an invaluable resource that allows us to sustain life.

If you happen to have some, I will pay you very handsomely for it.
[ES] {@RawItem:206821} es famoso por sus maravillosos poderes de purificación. Vaya, solo es posible depender del oasis del pueblo para nuestra agua potable porque hay {@RawItem:206821} en el fondo de ese mismo oasis.

Es un recurso invaluable que nos permite sostener la vida.

Si resulta que tienes algo, te pagaré muy bien por ello.

[EN] Oh, you got it! Thank you!

People who rely on the oasis water will appreciate you for this, .
[ES] ¡Oh, lo conseguiste! ¡Gracias!

La gente que depende del agua del oasis te lo agradecerá, .

[EN] If you get me some {@RawItem:206821} to maintain the clear oasis, it would be greatly appreciated.
[ES] Si me consigues algo de {@RawItem:206821} para mantener el oasis limpio, te lo agradecería muchísimo.
